textbookText: 3. Write the name of chromosome that determine the sex.
Ans:- the name of chromosome that determine the sex is sex chromosome.
4. Give definition of genotype.
Ans:- The genetic makeup of an organism is called genotype.
5. What is hybrid?
Ans:- An organism produced by crossing two different varieties is called hybrid.
6. State Mendel's law of purity of gametes.
Ans:- Mendel's law of purity of gametes state that “Each gamete carries only one factor for each character”.
7. State Mendel's law of dominance.
Ans:- Mendel's law of dominance state that “In a pair of contrasting characters, one is dominant and the other is recessive”.
8. How many characters of pea plant was selected by Mendel in his experiment?
Ans:- Seven characters of pea plant was selected by Mendel in his experiment.
9. Who is known as father of genetics?
Ans:- Gregor Johann Mendel is known as father of genetics.
10. From what two substances chromosome is made up of?
Ans:- Chromosome is made up of two substances DNA and protein.
11. Define monohybrid cross.
Ans:- A cross between two organisms considering a single character is called monohybrid cross.
12. Write the full form of DNA
Ans:- The full form of DNA is Deoxyribonucleic Acid.
13. What is meant by genetic engineering?
Ans:- The technique of altering or transferring genes to produce desired characters is called genetic engineering.
14. A women pregnant. What is her probability of giving birth to a daughter? Write in percent.
Ans:- The probability of giving birth to a daughter by a pregnant women is 50%.
15. What is genetics?
Ans:- The branch of biology that studies heredity and variation is called genetics.
16. What is DNA testing?
Ans:- A test done to analyze DNA to identify individuals or relationships is called DNA testing.
17. For what purposes DNA testing is used?
Ans:- DNA testing is used for the purposes of paternity test, criminal investigation, and disease diagnosis.
18. Mention the importance of DNA in genetic technology.
Ans:- DNA helps in gene cloning, genetic engineering, and development of medicines.
19. A teenage girl who has lost her mental balance became the victim of rape and gave birth to a child. How can the father of
the child be detected?
Ans:- If a teenage girl who has lost her mental balance became the victim of rape and gave birth to a child. By DNA test can
the father of the child be detected.
Section "C"
Short answer type questions.
1. Differentiate between autosome & sex chromosome in two points.
Ans:- The differences between autosome and sex chromosome are
Autosome
Sex chromosome
Autosomes determine body characters.
Sex chromosomes determine the sex of an individual.
Humans have 22 pairs of autosomes.
1 pair of sex chromosomes.
2. Write any two differences between haploid chromosome and diploid chromosome.
Ans:-The differences between haploid chromosome and diploid chromosome are
haploid chromosome
diploid chromosome
Haploid cells contain one set of chromosomes (n).
Diploid cells contain two sets (2n).
Haploid cells are found in gametes.
Diploid cells are found in body (somatic) cells.
3. Why is Mendal called "Father of Genetics"?
Ans:- Mendal is called "Father of Genetics" because he discovered the fundamental laws of heredity through his experiments
on pea plants.
4. Explain the reason that only one character is found to be expressed in Fi generation of Mendel's experiment with example.
Ans:- only one character is found to be expressed in Fi generation of Mendel's experiment because of the law of dominance,
the dominant character expresses itself while the recessive character remains hidden. Example: In a cross between tall (TT)
and dwarf (tt) pea plants, all F₁ plants are tall.
